purpose: Canonical signal interpretation for public cameras. Structured observations only unless media retention rights are explicitly verified.

cameras.negative_scope: At most: no unusual pier-area human or biological activity was observed in the visible frame during the stated interval.
cameras.timing_weight: Activity signals have highest information value in the pre-dawn/dawn Jubilee window and lower value during normal daytime use.

cameras.negative_scope: A lack of visible biological or human activity applies only to the water/activity actually visible in this west-southwest frame and stated interval. It is not a negative for unseen Point Clear, Zundel's or Mullet Point shoreline segments.

shoreline_detectability_context.corridor: Grand Hotel / Point Clear south through Zundel's toward Mullet Point
shoreline_detectability_context.owner_observation: Beaches at the Grand Hotel and south toward Zundel's are shallow and sandy and are places where Jubilees are often found because stranded or concentrated animals are relatively easy to see.
shoreline_detectability_context.interpretation: This is a detectability/access geometry prior, not direct evidence that a Jubilee is occurring and not proof that events are physically more frequent there.
shoreline_detectability_context.bias_guardrail: Higher report frequency along easy-to-see sandy shoreline can reflect higher observation/detection probability. Preserve this separately from latent physical occurrence probability.

general_rules: Stale, frozen, dark, obstructed or poor-visibility views are UNKNOWN.
A negative applies only to the visible area and stated observation interval.
Human searching is a soft precursor/detection signal, not Jubilee confirmation.
Multiple mirrors of one physical camera share one independence group.

live_player_freshness_policy.method: Inspect permitted live player directly; page/search text and preview stills alone do not verify video freshness.
checks: Observe player state (LIVE/live-position control), advancing playback and seekable endpoint across two samples, and actual visible scene progression.
Use roughly 10–30 seconds between observations when possible. Measure actual interval; do not claim continuous viewing between sampled inspections.
A fresh live session with advancing frames and advancing live window near its endpoint supports probably_fresh live observation; total source-to-view delay remains unknown.
An unlabelled Update Timestamp is not a capture timestamp until its semantics are independently established. UTC conversion is an assumption, not proof of image age.

If live playback is verified despite ambiguous metadata, admit scoped qualitative observations as probably_fresh, exact delay unknown. If only a still or page text is accessible, freshness=unknown, not stale merely from the page clock.
Use stale only with established capture-age evidence; use frozen only with sufficient playback/scene evidence. A motionless scene alone need not be frozen.
Do not promote these observations into clean training controls or change predictor weights without the existing validation gates.
live_player_freshness_policy.retention: Retain structured observations and playback metadata only in the model. Transient visual inspection is not an image archive; do not save/download/upload media to repository, Library or other storage.
live_player_freshness_policy.historical_correction: Earlier September 7 stale-image conclusions based solely on the Hazcams page Update Timestamp are unverified. Preserve original records; reinterpret freshness as unknown unless independent capture evidence exists. No retrospective conversion to fresh observations.
